review_candidates.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The role As a Cloud & Digital Workplace Engineer, you will be responsible for the administration, support, and optimization of both Azure cloud and on-prem server environments . You are confident in troubleshooting, scripting, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Troubleshoot complex incidents and root cause issues (e.g., VM performance, connectivity, failed backups). Maintain server security posture (e.g., Defender, firewalls, identity/access).
